verdict.rationale: Cake ships a few built-in automations that run without manual work once configured. Vesting schedules automate cliffs, milestones and pauses, and the registered agent is notified automatically on share issuances, transfers or conversions. There is no general automation or workflow builder, and the MCP integration is read-only, so AI-native users cannot define their own autonomous background jobs. Missing for 10: a user-defined automation or workflow builder, scheduled or triggered custom jobs, agent-driven write actions, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automate cliffs, schedules, milestones, and pauses without manual work.
Cake can automatically notify your registered agent whenever you make share issuances, transfers, or conversions.
Complete board sign-offs and e-signing in minutes with automated flows.
